|game_text=Deploy on table. Opponent's characters deploy +1 to same site as Jabba's Prize. When you capture a character, opponent loses 1 Force. Your Force drains at same battleground site as Jabba's Prize are +1. My Favorite Decoration may not be placed out of play. [Immune to Alter.]

This is the original printed text (version 1 of 4). The current text is [[Despair (V) (Errata 3)]] (PC-E3). Each version below is quoted with its dated source, in date order; bracketed names such as [Pilot] stand for icons printed on the cards, ▲ is the icon for “take into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle” and ▼ the icon for “deploy from Reserve Deck; reshuffle”.
* '''Original''' (this page): Players Committee 2014 Virtual Set 1 preview<ref name="eh1351-despair-0">[https://www.scribd.com/document/248870122/Star-Wars-CCG-Virtual-Card-Expansion-Set-1 Players Committee, 2014 Set 1 preview, p. 1 (public mirror)].</ref>. Dated 2014 (Set 1 preview); the day of first publication is not known.{{Mystery|question=On what day was this version of Despair (V) first published}} Text: “Deploy on table. Opponent's characters deploy +1 to same site as Jabba's Prize. When you capture a character, opponent loses 1 Force. Your Force drains at same battleground site as Jabba's Prize are +1. My Favorite Decoration may not be placed out of play. [Immune to Alter.]” No errata mark.
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Despair (V) (Errata)]]): Players Committee Official Errata list<ref name="eh1351-despair-1">[https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1dXwBAYCUyBvWHpZc-oSCedmOZUb5f9vSDzUdvV2dUTY/export?format=csv Players Committee, Official Errata list, 22 March 2020].</ref>. First published 22 March 2020. The card image with this text is in the PC Holotable repository from 12 May 2020 (commit a5142dd). Text: “Deploy on table. My Favorite Decoration may not be placed out of play. At same site as Jabba's Prize, opponent's characters deploy +1 and your Force drains are +1. While Jabba's Prize with Scum And Villainy, your total power in all battles is +3. [Immune to Alter.]” '''What changed:''' game text: new or changed words “At same site as Jabba's Prize, opponent's characters deploy +1 and your Force drains are +1. While Jabba's Prize with Scum And Villainy, your total power in all battles is +3.”; words removed: “. Opponent's characters deploy +1 to same site as Jabba's Prize. When you capture a character, opponent loses 1 Force. Your Force drains at same battleground site as Jabba's Prize are +1”; the printed errata mark is now “E” (was “none”). It prints the errata mark “E”.
* '''PC-E2''' ([[Despair (V) (Errata 2)]]): Players Committee card image<ref name="eh1351-despair-2">Players Committee card image <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual1-Dark/large/despair.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable repository, version of [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/ca1ccff62ff30b7e29da803f91a6d09ab542d803 commit ca1ccff] (3 October 2022).</ref>. First published 3 October 2022. Text: “Deploy on table. My Favorite Decoration may not be placed out of play. At same site as Jabba's Prize, opponent's characters deploy +1 and your Force drains are +1. While Jabba's Prize with Scum And Villainy, your total power in all battles is +3. [Immune to Alter.]” '''What changed:''' the words are the same: the printed errata mark is now “E1” (was “E”). It prints the errata mark “E1”.
* '''PC-E3''' ([[Despair (V) (Errata 3)]]): Players Committee 30 December 2024 errata<ref name="eh1351-despair-3">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/virtual/Errata_2024_12_30.pdf#page=2 Players Committee, 30 December 2024 errata, p. 2].</ref>. First published 30 December 2024. The PC card image with this text was committed to the Holotable repository the same day (commit 9d2c01e). Text: “Deploy on table. My Favorite Decoration may not be placed out of play. At battlegrounds where you have a frozen captive, your Force drains are +1. While a frozen captive with Scum And Villainy, your total power in all battles is +3. [Immune to Alter.]” '''What changed:''' game text: new or changed words “battlegrounds where you have a frozen captive”, “a frozen captive”; words removed: “opponent's characters deploy +1 and”; the printed errata mark is now “E2” (was “E1”). It prints the errata mark “E2”. This is the current text.
